query:
SELECT id, jobType, status, totalItems, processedItems, successCount, errorCount, 
       JSON_EXTRACT(config, '$.customNumberField') as customNumberField,
       JSON_EXTRACT(config, '$.customNumberValue') as customNumberValue,
       JSON_EXTRACT(config, '$.customLabel4') as customLabel4,
       JSON_EXTRACT(config, '$.catalogId') as catalogId,
       JSON_EXTRACT(config, '$.updateCriteria.description') as updateDescription,
       createdAt
FROM batch_jobs 
WHERE jobType = 'catalog_update' 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 20;
